tools.name: search_stays
tools.description: Search homes on Travelino by city or country. Add check-in and check-out dates to get only the homes that are free on those dates, each with its exact total price. Returns up to 20 homes, each with a link.

tools.name: get_stay
tools.description: Full details of one home on Travelino: description, amenities, booking rules (minimum and maximum nights, check-in and check-out times, cancellation policy), photos and approximate location.

tools.name: get_availability
tools.description: Day-by-day availability and nightly prices for one home, starting from a date you choose. For the exact total of a stay, use get_quote.

tools.name: get_quote
tools.description: Exact total price for one home, dates and number of guests, line by line (nights, cleaning, extra guests, taxes), or the reason it cannot be booked for those dates. Includes the booking link on travelino.com.

tools.name: get_host_program
tools.description: How owners list a home on Travelino: who can list, the host service fee, how many Founding Hosts places are still open and the sign-up link.
